tools.description: Look up a published proof by its ID on Intentrax's public verifier (verify.intentrax.com) and return the verifier's status and per-dimension assessment. Read-only. tools.name: intentrax_get_trusted_key_set
tools.description: Return the published Ed25519 signer key set Intentrax proofs are checked against (production: trust-bearing, min_trusted_signers applies; sandbox: never trust-bearing), with its SHA-256, so the user can verify a proof offline with `npx @intentrax/sdk verify-proof --trusted-keys`. Read-only; no netwo

tools.name: intentrax_verify_proof_export
tools.description: Verify an exported proof package (the JSON from GET /v1/proofs/{id}/export or the console's Export button) against Intentrax's published production and sandbox keys, using the same verifier as `npx @intentrax/sdk verify-proof --json`. Pure computation: no network call, nothing is stored. status PASS

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "intentrax_get_trusted_key_set" appears informational but accepts parameters (environment) that enable code/file/secret access.
